name: Morikawa Mitsuru
source: A young woman who teaches Physics at Ainami, and acts as Homura's homeroom teacher for her second year. Though she's only just started teaching this year, she's already made friends with her coworkers, and is generally well-received by students. She wants the best for her students, and has chosen to pay special attention to Homura's development as a student by tutoring her in piano on weekends.
